authoring: Source-authored from pinned official code after unchanged CPU parser viability check; no model/ranking or new Express/Zod clause outcomes inspected. Query text is behavior-first, not chosen to activate the splitter. Neutral semantic review required before future inference.
target_groups_semantics: OR within each group; AND across all groups. Credit requires one verified excerpt containing each complete executable evidence span. Function bodies are deliberately complete, including guards; matching names/comments are insufficient.

queries.query: Assign a default media type and UTF-8 byte length for a string response; answer a header-only request without transmitting that body.
queries.notes: Local body assignment and final header-only response dispatch are both required. Existing content types are respected; this asks local control/assignment, not external MIME tables or Node byte-encoding internals.

queries.query: For an unwritten, writable response, translate a middleware failure into a safe status and text reply, disclose details only when explicitly allowed, clear old headers and emit an application error.
queries.notes: Promise rejection/finished-response errors delegate from request handling to the context error body. Valid specified error headers are reapplied except generated content type/length; unknown status defaults to500. Already sent/unwritable responses only emit and cannot be rewritten.

queries.query: Treat compatible readable streams as response bodies, attach completion cleanup, discard stale lengths when swapping bodies, and forward transmission errors when an application error listener exists.
queries.notes: Require local native/structural stream classification, assignment cleanup/length handling, and final pipeline plus conditional error forwarding. Replacing an old stream with another stream attaches an error sink rather than destroying the old stream; no stronger destruction claim is made. Node pipeline and external destroy/on-finished algorithms are outside lib scope.

queries.query: Determine and cache the client address, trusting a forwarded chain only when enabled, limiting it to the configured number of hops, and falling back to the socket address.
queries.notes: The forwarded-list getter uses the configured header and last allowed hops only with proxy trust; the client-address getter caches first remaining address or socket fallback. Same-file AND evidence, not a multi-file case.

queries.query: Send a relocation response with a safely encoded destination, retain an existing redirect status, and choose escaped HTML or plain text according to the client’s accepted format.
queries.notes: The local helper normalizes absolute http(s) destinations, sets encoded Location, defaults non-redirect status to302, escapes HTML and otherwise sends text. External URL/encoding/content-negotiation package internals are outside scope.

queries.query: Validate request freshness only for GET or HEAD with a successful response or a not-modified status; other method and status combinations should return a negative freshness result.
queries.notes: This asks the local method/status gate before delegation to the fresh package, not the external conditional-header comparison algorithm.

queries.query: Fetch remote resources named in an incoming request body and automatically retry failed downloads with exponential backoff.
queries.notes: Scoped to pinned tracked lib core. It provides an inbound HTTP application and response helpers, not an outbound request-body link fetch/retry system; user middleware and dependencies are outside scope.

queries.query: Encrypt outgoing JSON bodies with tenant-specific rotating keys and include the active key identifier in each encrypted payload.
queries.notes: Scoped to pinned tracked lib core. Plain JSON serialization, cookie signing-key support and ordinary response headers are not body encryption/key rotation; user middleware/dependencies are excluded.
